name: Veracity
definition: How accurate and non-misleading the politician's factual claims are, checked against sources.

name: Focus
definition: Whether the politician engages the policy question or simply attacks the other party.

name: Civility
definition: Commitment to constructive dialogue over personal attacks. Criticising a policy hard is civil; turning on the person is not.

name: Rigor
definition: Whether conclusions follow logically from their assumptions. Not a fact-check — the accuracy of the assumptions is Veracity.

name: Specificity
definition: The meaningfulness of the politician's statements (vague platitudes score low).

name: Acuity
definition: Whether the politician takes up the argument in front of them, or delivers a speech that would be identical whoever spoke before.
